key.name: bootstrap-loaded-generation
key.summary: Internal bootstrap generation loaded by GNOME Shell

key.name: bootstrap-loaded-revision
key.summary: Internal bootstrap fingerprint loaded by GNOME Shell

key.name: runtime-loaded-revision
key.summary: Runtime revision currently loaded by the bootstrap

key.name: orb-icon
key.summary: Themed icon name or absolute SVG/PNG path used by the Orb

key.name: auto-hide-orb
key.summary: Slide the Orb to the nearest monitor edge while idle

key.name: auto-hide-delay
key.summary: Milliseconds before the idle Orb auto-hides

key.name: auto-fade-orb
key.summary: Fade the Orb while idle when auto-hide is disabled

key.name: auto-fade-delay
key.summary: Milliseconds before the idle Orb fades

key.name: icon-gap
key.summary: Minimum gap between Orb launcher icons

key.name: ring-gap
key.summary: Distance between Orb radial launcher rings

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: Hover delay before the Orb radial launcher opens

key.name: close-delay
key.summary: Delay before the Orb radial launcher closes

key.name: show-tooltips
key.summary: Show application names around the Orb launcher

key.name: show-running-indicator
key.summary: Show running indicators on Orb launcher applications

key.name: app-preview-size
key.summary: Live Orb application preview size percentage

key.name: spotlight-enabled
key.description: Shows the centered Velora application search with Super+Space.

key.name: panel-menu-hover-switch
key.summary: Switch between open panel menus on hover
key.description: When enabled, moving the pointer onto another panel menu source can switch to it after the configured dwell. When disabled, crossing panel icons does not open their menus; click and keyboard activation remain immediate.

key.name: panel-menu-hover-delay-ms
key.description: Milliseconds the pointer must continuously remain over another panel menu source before switching to it while a panel menu is already open.

key.name: dock-vertical-offset
key.description: Vertical paint offset in pixels. Positive values move the floating dock upward; negative values move it downward. Panel mode ignores this setting.

key.name: glass-optics-profile-version
key.summary: Internal Velora full-glass optics profile version

key.name: glass-opacity
key.summary: System Liquid Glass tint strength percentage

key.name: glass-filter-opacity
key.description: Low-opacity white veil painted above the refractive material and below native content.

key.name: date-menu-glass-opacity
key.description: Independent micro-tuning for the Date/Calendar popup.

key.name: date-menu-glass-blur
key.description: Independent low blur radius for a clearer refractive Date Menu.

key.name: date-menu-glass-filter-opacity
key.description: Neutral white veil for the Date/Calendar popup only.

key.name: glass-live-scene-fps
key.description: Caps expensive live window-clone synchronization while keeping Shell geometry and interaction on the native frame clock.
